name: exec_command
description: Runs a command in a PTY, returning output or a session ID for ongoing interaction. Returns unchanged JSON {job,end,output,path,cursor,wall_time_seconds}; end is null while running.

description.description: What it does, in a few plain words for the person.

workdir.description: Working directory for the command. Defaults to the turn cwd.

tty.description: True allocates a PTY for the command; false or omitted uses plain pipes.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding output. Defaults to 10000 ms; effective range is 250-30000 ms.

max_output_tokens.description: Output token budget. Defaults to 10000 tokens; larger requests may be capped by policy.

name: write_stdin
description: Writes characters to an existing unified exec session and returns recent output. Returns unchanged JSON {job,end,output,path,cursor,wall_time_seconds}. secret_file reads host-side bytes instead of chars; never put a secret in chars.

session_id.description: Identifier of the running unified exec session.

chars.description: Bytes to write to stdin. Defaults to empty, which polls without writing.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding output. Non-empty writes default to 250 ms and cap at 30000 ms; empty polls wait 5000-300000 ms by default.

max_output_tokens.description: Output token budget. Defaults to 10000 tokens; larger requests may be capped by policy.

secret_file.description: Host-side UTF-8 file to type, instead of chars; the record holds only this path.

name: apply_patch
description: The `apply_patch` tool can be used to edit files. This is a FREEFORM tool, so do not wrap the patch in JSON.

name: view_image
description: View a local image file from the filesystem when visual inspection is needed. Use this for images already available on disk.

path.description: Local filesystem path to an image file.

name: read
description: Read a file by lines. Paths are relative to the session cwd. Output contains absolute path, first line, lines, and next (null at EOF). Long lines and windows are bounded; use next to continue. A PNG, JPEG or WebP file comes back as the image itself, not lines.

name: write
description: Write content to a file, creating missing parent directories. Output contains its path and whether the file was created. Use edit for a small change to an existing file.

name: edit
description: Replace one exact string in a file. No match or several matches refuses without changing the file unless replace_all is true. Output names the path and number of replacements.

name: bash
description: Run a shell command in a fresh bash. cwd and environment do not carry between calls. Output is unchanged JSON {job,end,output,path,cursor,wall_time_seconds}; end is null while the job runs.

description.description: What it does, in a few plain words for the person.

name: wait
description: Wait for a shell job; timeout_ms defaults to zero (peek). Returns the unchanged job JSON.

name: send
description: Send exactly one of text, key, secret_file, or end:true to a shell job. secret_file is the only secret form. Then wait as for wait.

name: kill
description: Stop this session’s shell job and return its unchanged job JSON.

name: mcp_search
description: Find up to five MCP tools by names and descriptions; matching tools become callable natively for the rest of this session. Returns names and one-line descriptions, not schemas.

name: skill
description: Read a named SKILL.md from the configured skills directories. Output contains name, dir, output and path.

name: recall
description: Read a record entry whole by id (#N in a rebuilt context means id N). With only session, return its digest: inputs, replies, failures, memory/task calls and changed files, at most 24 KiB. With query, search the person's past conversations here and on paired servers, newest first: each conversation's newest entry holding all query words; add session for every matching entry there. Read a hit with its session and entry as id.

session.description: A conversation's session; alone reads its digest. Use <id>@<server> for a paired server.

query.description: Words, each the start of a word, all in one entry; case and accents do not matter.

name: search
description: Search the web; returns up to ten titles, URLs and excerpts in {output,path}, with the provider on the first line. Search with your native web tool first and for routine work; use this when it did not find what you need, or to check a claim a second, independent way.
generic: Search the web; returns up to ten titles, URLs and excerpts in {output,path}, with the provider on the first line.

name: fetch
description: Fetch extracted text from a URL; optional literal find returns matching lines and neighbours, or no matches. Returns {output,path}, with the provider on the first line; path names the whole text when spilled. Fetch with your native web tool first; use this when it did not get what you need, the page refused it, or a claim needs a second, independent check.
generic: Fetch extracted text from a URL; optional literal find returns matching lines and neighbours, or no matches. Returns {output,path}, with the provider on the first line; path names the whole text when spilled.

name: answer
description: Get a web-grounded answer and citations from the configured provider, not a Razor synthesis. Returns {output,path}, with the provider on the first line. Use your native web tools first and for routine work; use this when they did not find what you need, or to check a claim a second, independent way.
generic: Get a web-grounded answer and citations from the configured provider, not a Razor synthesis. Returns {output,path}, with the provider on the first line.

name: agent
description: A top-level agent can start a top-level session for the person, here or on a paired server. When a report is all you need, settle the helper with discard. Start, continue, wait for, finish, stop or settle a child; set your headline or rename this session. One wait covers all children and jobs: the next report, mail or Razor notice (a background job's end among them), or null at its timeout, the person's input or a rebuild. Before settlement, continue finished/stopped/interrupted children; message working ones. Settle reports: merge merges the branch, merged records your git merge, discard leaves it unmerged.

name.description: start: tree-unique child name (letters, digits, _, -). name: this session's one-line name, shown to the person.

brief.description: start_top: the new session's first note; start, continue: the child's whole task. It already has its startup files (by default the project's AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md) and nothing else of your work.

shared_brief.description: start: a file whose text goes before the brief.

task.description: start: a task's number to claim for the child; its report lands on it at settle.

kind.description: start: worker by default; reviewer/researcher only adds role text.

server.description: start_top, start: paired server enrollment name; default here. The folder resolves there, and a child's settlement merge too.

cwd.description: start_top, start: the folder relative to yours on the selected server; an absolute path selects another folder.

placement.description: start: git worktree/branch from your last commit; uncommitted edits are invisible. For those, commit first or use in_place.

model.description: start_top: the project's default unless given; start: yours unless given; continue: the child's own unless given. Claude: opus, sonnet, haiku, fable; GPT: sol, terra, luna, astra; or a full id from the model list.

effort.description: start_top: the project's default unless given; start: yours unless given; continue: the child's own unless given.

speed.description: start: standard when absent, even under a fast parent. Increase only on the person's explicit request; continue: keeps the child's choice unless given.

child.description: continue, stop, settle: the child's name or session id.

decision.description: settle: merge, record your merge, or leave unmerged.

report.description: finish: what you did and what is left, for your parent.

name: message
description: Send a note, question or answer to any agent, or post a note to your tree's channel with `to: channel`; read the channel; list or search the agents you can reach. Copy your parent on anything that changes your task's scope. In a top-level session or resident, `parent` is the person, and a note is a notification on their phone under your name.

to.description: Who gets it: `channel` posts to your tree's shared channel, where an @name in the text wakes that agent; `parent`; or any agent, in your tree or not, by session id, name or project, with @server for a paired server (list shows them). A name two agents share is refused; send by id.

text.description: To the person: one line, answer first, under 120 characters of plain words; no paths, ids, code or Markdown. To an agent: all it needs, at any length.

question.description: answer: required; the id of the question you answer, as it arrived.

options.description: question to the person: answers to offer.

limit.description: read: the latest 20 posts unless given.

query.description: list: only agents whose id, name, project, repository or headline holds it.

voice.description: Speak this note to the person (roots only, to parent) only when they asked for a voice note or are away; it is that stretch's one note. One line, as long as the content needs, in plain words only: no URLs, paths, code or hashes, and at most two delivery tags. It plays once, in an active local terminal or else on the phone, and never in quiet hours. On refusal, write instead.

requested.description: Set true only when the person explicitly asked for this voice note; default false.

name: status
description: Read the agents in your tree and their current work.

name: memory
description: A ruling governs future work, citing the person's message. File it under the project it concerns.

description.description: fact/note summary; page: when to read.

replaces.description: id or ruling ids; omit text to retire.

cites.description: 32 max: razor:<session>:l-<entry>, file:<path>@<commit>, ref:<path>, url:<url> <date>, task:<number>.

resident.description: Your resident's layer: what no other agent here would do better knowing.

project.description: Folder, relative to session; not with all.

name: task
description: Claim tasks before working; close with evidence. Claims end at close.

claim.description: Claim or release; another's release needs the person's word.

name: deliver
description: Deliver a file or URL to the person.

line.description: one line saying what it is.

name: handover
description: Rebuild your context from the session's record once every call of this message has its result, and continue in it with `note`, your continuation note.

note.description: A few lines on the work in hand and the decisions behind it, not a summary of the past.
